# mewa_ui

Semantic HTML, tokenized CSS, local SVG icons, and optional native JavaScript behaviors.

Read `README.md` for release installation and `library/DESIGN.md` for system boundaries and conditional task routes.

## Consumer routes

- Selection: `library/system/components.md#selection-order`, then candidate metadata and only selected component contracts.
- Markup, keyboard, state, events, and fallback: the selected `library/components/{category}/{slug}/{slug}.md`.
- Visual changes: the relevant section of `library/system/foundations.md`.
- Repeated regions: the relevant section of `library/system/patterns.md`.
- Application chrome: `library/system/layouts.md#choose-a-shell` and the selected recipe.
- Interaction acceptance: relevant sections of `library/system/accessibility.md` and the selected component contract.
- Mount/update/unmount: `library/runtime/README.md`; choose one lifecycle owner.

For a core archive with local contracts, find candidates in `components/index.md`, then read selected `components/{slug}.json` and `component.contractLocal`.

Use `manifest.json` for full inventory or `guidance` paths when needed.

Icons are optional assets from the separate `mewa-icons` archive; inline SVG needs no loader.

<!-- REPOSITORY-ONLY:START -->
## Source-checkout routes

- `AGENTS.md`: repository ownership, generation, compatibility, and validation.
- `registry.json`: source registry v3 selection, exact file paths, dependencies, assets, and token purposes.
- `registry.schema.json`: registry compatibility checks.
- `library/adapters/svelte/README.md`: source Svelte attachment and Bun compilation guide; the optional archive has its own README.
- `docs/preview.html#preview-{slug}`: component playgrounds, not another API authority.
- `docs/figma.html`: inert visual property and variant matrix for Figma import.

`library/` contains authored implementation and contracts; `dist/` contains generated release files.
<!-- REPOSITORY-ONLY:END -->
